measurement_scope.arrival: all rows arrive at batch start, before shared tokenization
measurement_scope.ttft: batch start to this row's first token decoded for delivery
measurement_scope.tpot: mean interval between this row's delivered tokens, excluding its first token
measurement_scope.request_e2e: batch start to this row's terminal completion/full-text detokenization; finished rows do not wait for remaining rows
measurement_scope.e2e_latency: whole-batch wall time, retained separately from per-request E2E
measurement_scope.profiling: a separate output-equivalent replay excluded from measured runs

distributed.interconnect_topology: 4 physical cards, 2 logical devices per card
distributed.legacy_memory_scope: last measured run, before optional profile; CPU zero is a compatibility sentinel

command: 4 physical cards, 2 logical devices per card
